{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative (sentiment < 0) to account for bearish market pressure.",
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes by applying a 10-15% dampening factor to the immediate next period.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast deviates > ±10% from recent 5-day average, adjust toward the average.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to sentiment when sentiment > 0.5 — model should react more aggressively to bullish signals.",
    "For long-term horizons (>15 days), reduce forecast volatility by smoothing with a 3-period moving average if sentiment is neutral or negative.",
    "When sentiment is positive and price is trending downward, apply a downward bias correction to prevent over-optimism.",
    "If forecast consistently overestimates true price in early periods (e.g., 1-3 days), reduce initial forecast by 5-10% to account for lag."
  ]
}
